name: Moorline
tagline: Every slip, every season, one dashboard.
positioning: Moorline is the operating system for independent marinas — slip booking, billing, and maintenance in one calm place.

hero.h1: Run your marina like it runs itself
hero.sub: Slip reservations, seasonal contracts, utility metering, and work orders — unified for harbormasters who'd rather be on the water than in a spreadsheet.

features.title: Live slip map
features.description: A real-time visual of every berth, from transient overnights to decade-long seasonal tenants.

features.title: Automated billing
features.description: Metered electric, pump-outs, and winter storage invoiced automatically, on schedule.

features.title: Waitlist intelligence
features.description: Fill cancellations in hours, not weeks, with ranked waitlists that text boaters for you.

testimonials.quote: We filled 40 slips off the waitlist in one weekend. My clipboard is in a drawer somewhere.
testimonials.name: Dale Petersen

testimonials.quote: Billing season used to take my entire January. Now it takes an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Rosa Alvarez

testimonials.quote: The live slip map alone is worth it. Our dockhands actually know where to send people.
testimonials.name: Gord MacLeish

pricing.blurb: For marinas under 75 slips getting off paper.
Everything a working marina needs in season.

homepage.footerBlurb: Moorline is the calm operating system for independent marinas everywhere the water meets the dock.
